        """Place an order for ``(sku, quantity)`` pairs at current catalogue prices."""
        if self._customers.get(customer_id) is None:
            raise CustomerNotFound(customer_id)

            product = self._catalog.get(sku)

"""Warehouse fulfilment: packing slips."""

from __future__ import annotations

from orders.application.errors import Conflict, CustomerNotFound, OrderNotFound, ProductNotFound
from orders.domain.fulfilment import PackingSlip, PackingSlipLine
from orders.infrastructure.catalog import InMemoryProductCatalog
from orders.infrastructure.customers import InMemoryCustomerRepository
from orders.infrastructure.repository import InMemoryOrderRepository


class FulfilmentService:
    def __init__(self, orders: InMemoryOrderRepository, customers: InMemoryCustomerRepository,
                 catalog: InMemoryProductCatalog) -> None:
        self._orders = orders
        self._customers = customers
        self._catalog = catalog

    def packing_slip(self, order_id: str) -> PackingSlip:
        order = self._orders.get(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise OrderNotFound(order_id)
        if order.status == "cancelled":
            raise Conflict(f"order {order_id} is cancelled")
        customer = self._customers.get(order.customer_id)
        if customer is None:
            raise CustomerNotFound(order.customer_id)
        lines = []
        for item in order.items:
            product = self._catalog.get(item.sku)
            if product is None:
                raise ProductNotFound(item.sku)
            lines.append(PackingSlipLine(item.sku, product.name, item.quantity))
        return PackingSlip(order.order_id, customer.name, tuple(lines))

def place(shop, *items):
    return shop.orders.handle_create({"customer_id": "c1", "items": [
        {"sku": s, "quantity": q} for s, q in items]}).body["order_id"]


def test_packing_slip(shop):
    oid = place(shop, ("PEN", 2), ("BOOK", 1))
    r = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip(oid)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert r.body == {"order_id": oid, "customer_name": "Ada", "lines": [
        {"sku": "PEN", "name": "Pen", "quantity": 2}, {"sku": "BOOK", "name": "Book", "quantity": 1}]}


def test_packing_slip_unknown_order(shop):
    r = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip("nope")
    assert (r.status, r.body) == (404, {"error": "order not found"})


def test_packing_slip_cancelled_order(shop):
    oid = place(shop, ("PEN", 1))
    shop.orders.handle_cancel(oid)
    r = shop.fulfilment.handle_packing_slip(oid)
    assert r.status == 409 and "error" in r.body


def test_low_stock_sorted_and_strict(shop):
    shop.catalog.handle_add_product({"sku": "AAA", "name": "Aaa", "unit_price_cents": 1, "on_hand": 5})
    r = shop.fulfilment.handle_low_stock(100)
    assert r.status == 200
    assert r.body["products"] == [
        {"sku": "AAA", "name": "Aaa", "on_hand": 5},
        {"sku": "LAMP", "name": "Lamp", "on_hand": 5},
        {"sku": "BOOK", "name": "Book", "on_hand": 50},

    assert shop.fulfilment.handle_low_stock(5).body == {"products": []}


def test_restock_adds_stock_and_is_orderable(shop):
    r = shop.fulfilment.handle_restock({"sku": "LAMP", "quantity": 10})
